# NiceTryGPT v0.5.0 ☕🤖

**Structural generalization, without synthetic evidence.**

v0.5.0 broadens the deterministic transformation artifact while keeping the empirical solver dataset unchanged.

## Highlights

- five bundled deterministic demos, adding command injection and server-side template injection;
- all five documented resistance patterns are now represented in committed transformations;
- executable challenge adapters for every bundled demo;
- a generated structural-generalization matrix spanning seven recorded vulnerability classes across five bundled and two external transformations;
- adapter and generalization checks integrated into the unified research-artifact verifier;
- release-time Software Heritage preservation fix carried forward from the post-v0.4 maintenance update.

## Evidence boundary

This release adds **no new paid model observations**.

The empirical dataset remains exactly the v0.3.0/v0.4.0 dataset: 50 raw attempts, 23 valid solver observations, and 27 infrastructure failures. Interstellar Ingress remains the completed 5+5 GPT cell; DiceMiner remains 10 valid BEFORE + 3 valid AFTER and resource-bounded partial. The Claude attempt still provides no valid solver observation.

The new demos and adapter matrix provide deterministic/structural evidence only. v0.5.0 does not claim universal LLM resistance, empirically unchanged human difficulty, cross-model replication, or population-level model generalization.
